items.title: Jameson Williams: Breaks season-long TD drought
items.text:
Williams brought in two of four targets for 47 yards and two touchdowns in the Lions' 45-21 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.

items.title: Brock Bowers: Stays productive in tough Week 5 loss
items.text:
Bowers caught eight of 10 targets for 110 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 45-17 loss to the Patriots.

items.title: Zach Charbonnet: Will sit again Week 6
items.text:
Charbonnet (knee) won't be activated from the reserve/PUP list ahead of Thursday's game versus the Broncos, Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said after Sunday's 32-29 loss to the 49ers, Corbin Smith of Emerald City Spectrum reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Justin Herbert: Two more turnovers in Week 5
items.text:
Herbert completed 14 of 24 passes for 121 yards, one touchdown and one interception, reeled off 54 yards on six carries and fumbled twice (one lost) during Sunday's 23-17 loss to the Broncos.

items.title: Trey McBride: Busy as usual in Week 5 loss
items.text:
McBride brought in nine of 10 targets for 66 yards and a touchdown in the Cardinals' 45-21 loss to the Lions on Sunday.

items.title: Omarion Hampton: Musters 39 total yards in Week 5
items.text:
Hampton turned 14 carries into 33 yards and one target into a six-yard catch during Sunday's 23-17 loss to the Broncos.

items.title: Amon-Ra St. Brown: Six catches in Week 5 win
items.text:
St. Brown secured six of 11 targets for 69 yards and committed two fumbles that remained with Detroit in the Lions' 45-21 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.

items.title: Jahmyr Gibbs: Eclipses 200 scrimmage yards in win
items.text:
Gibbs rushed 25 times for 151 yards and two touchdowns while bringing in five of six targets for 56 yards in the Lions' 45-21 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
